pages.observed: Five frames 0.0 to 0.8 s of a vertical illustrated airport curb scene. A phone card showing a map route and Ride requested, an airplane pickup sign, a teal suitcase by a bench, a white generic car at left edge, and a lower caption reading Anyone in San Antonio can now hail a Waymo with no driver, from 0.6 s. Lower third of frame is empty dark asphalt.

Frames 1.0 to 1.8 s. The white car moves from the left edge to the right and stops in the painted bay with a red brake lamp lit. Phone card still reads Ride requested and Finding a car. Caption line one is unchanged. Large dark empty asphalt fills the lower third.

Frames 2.0 to 2.8 s. Exterior curb shot with car stopped in bay, then a Texas outline card shows at top right and a hard cut at 2.4 s to a cab interior with a black steering wheel, a map screen on the dash, empty gray seats and the airport sign through the windshield. The wheel angle shifts across the three interior frames. The phone card and caption remain overlaid.

Frames 3.0 to 3.8 s inside the cab. The steering wheel visibly turns with its tan marker travelling around the rim while both front seats are empty. The airport sign drifts out of the windshield to the right and the Texas card outline draws in more detail. The phone card still shows Ride requested. Same caption line stays.

Frames 4.0 to 4.8 s. Cab interior holds with empty seats and a still wheel for four frames, then at 4.8 s a hard cut to the curb exterior with an enlarged tilted phone card reading Ride requested overlapping the white car and the caption removed. A small orange dot sits on the Texas card.

Frames 5.0 to 5.8 s. A big tilted phone covers the left half of the parked white car. The phone label changes from Ride requested to Arriving At the curb around 5.6 s and the blue map pin slides onto the destination pin. Caption reads the airport included. The lower third of frame is plain dark road.

Frames 6.0 to 6.8 s. The phone card holds Arriving At the curb beside the parked car for four frames, no caption from 6.2 s. At 6.8 s a hard cut to a brown wooden table seen at an angle with a pale gridded map, three small pins, green patches and a February calendar block above it.

Frames 7.0 to 7.8 s. A gridded pale map lies on a brown table beneath a February calendar page. For the first three frames nothing changes, then thin blue river and tan street lines begin to draw in at 7.6 s. Caption reads The service began in February. A label card at top left and Texas card remain.

Frames 8.0 to 8.8 s. The map continues to draw: two blue river lines lengthen, tan roads radiate, and a loose tan oval ring around the three pins grows. The Texas card dims then disappears. February calendar tab stays unchanged. Caption still The service began in February.

Frames 9.0 to 9.8 s. The camera pushes in on the map. At 9.4 s a tag reading 60 square miles Limited area appears with a red pin, black line strokes start drawing near it, and the February page slides in from the right edge to bottom left. Caption changes to in a limited area of sixty square miles. at 9.4 s.

Frames 10.0 to 10.8 s. A black outline is drawn step by step from the 60 square miles tag, circling the river and pins, and at 10.8 s it closes into a translucent gray polygon. February page rests at lower left of map. Caption reads in a limited area of sixty square miles.

Frames 11.0 to 11.8 s. The map with closed gray polygon, 60 square miles tag and February page is identical in all five frames. Pin positions differ by a few pixels only. Caption holds in a limited area of sixty square miles. A static hold of about one second ending at the cut to creek scene near 12.36 s.

Frames 12.0 to 12.8 s. Map stays still for two frames then cuts at 12.4 s to a top-down shot of a white car with a round roof pod parked on a brown water band, pale ledge stripes above and below, green bank with two round trees. Small white foam shapes at the car's right end. Over three frames the car and water look unchanged. Label says A different car April 20th account.

Frames 13.0 to 13.8 s. Top-down white car stays at the same screen position and same angle in every frame, with foam blobs fixed at its right end and ledge stripes unchanged. Water has only subtle shading variation. No rain patches or visible current motion read at this sampling. Caption The sentence about being swept into Salado Creek holds.

Frames 14.0 to 14.8 s. The overhead car edges left and turns a few degrees from 14.0 to 14.6 s. At 14.8 s the view is higher with a different layout, car lower right, new pale ledge notch and trees upper left. The car remains on the same bank band and does not look carried downstream through current.

Frames 15.0 to 15.8 s. From above, the white car is angled across the creek, turns further counter-clockwise, slides up-left and begins to exit the frame left at 15.8 s while foam and thin wake lines trail. The pale ledge stripes and trees stay in place behind. Caption is the same sentence about the creek.

Frames 16.0 to 16.8 s. The white car, tilted, exits at the left edge by 16.4 s carrying foam. From 16.6 s the creek and banks are empty and the caption is gone. The last two frames hold on empty water for a few tenths of a second before the cut to the next scene at 17.24 s.

Frames 17.0 to 17.8 s. Two frames of empty creek, then a hard cut at 17.4 s to a side view of a white car standing in brown floodwater on a street, with low beige houses, a fence, a live oak and green street signs behind it and a grey sidewalk in front. The car and water look unchanged across the three frames. Caption appears at 17.6 s.

Frames 18.0 to 18.8 s. The side-view white car sits in brown water that climbs from just under the door sills to above the wheel arches, with the car drifting a little to the right. No amber hazard lamps can be seen in these frames. Backdrop of houses, tree and signs is fixed. Caption holds Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater.

Frames 19.0 to 19.8 s. Amber hazard lamps flash at both ends of the white car at 19.2 and 19.4 s and are off at 19.6 s. At 19.8 s the view jumps to a closer shot of the car with the background houses and tree blurred, the car body larger, water just above the wheel rims and the windows showing grey seats. Caption holds.

Frames 20.0 to 20.8 s. Close side view of the white car sitting in brown water with the waterline just above the wheel rims and a reflection below. Amber hazard lamps flash on and off at front and rear across the frames, ripples ring the wheels, dark cabin shows seat silhouettes. Background is blurred. Caption holds.

Frames 21.0 to 21.8 s. The same close side view continues. Hazard lamps blink at both ends in alternating frames, the car stays put in the water with a reflection, background blurred. Caption present until 21.2 s and gone from 21.4 s. The shot is the third consecutive second of this single static composition with only blinking lamps and ripples changing.

Frames 22.0 to 22.8 s. A cut from the close flood shot to a wooden desk against olive green with a cream card titled Federal recall record, Vehicle safety recall, partly off right edge and a pen. The card slides left slightly and a small vertical cursor bar shows in the field area at 22.8 s. Caption Waymo filed a software recall from 22.6 s.

Frames 23.0 to 23.8 s. On the desk the cream recall card straightens and shifts left while text rows are typed: Recall type Software at 23.0 s, then Potential units affected 3,791 by 23.8 s. A pen rests at the right edge. Caption holds Waymo filed a software recall. The card is a flat paper card with a printed grid of small fields.

Frames 24.0 to 24.8 s. The completed recall card sits unchanged for four frames about one second with caption Waymo filed a software recall. At 24.8 s the layout shifts so the card is higher, a 10 by 5 grid of dashed boxes appears beneath with three tiny car icons filled in at top left, and a wooden stamp tip appears at right. New caption that could affect nearly thirty eight hundred cars.

Frames 25.0 to 25.8 s. White car icons fill a ten wide grid row by row while an arm in a blue sleeve brings a wooden stamp from the right edge over the card. The card values Software and 3,791 stay printed. At 25.8 s the stamp is still above the card with no stamp mark yet. Caption holds the sentence about nearly thirty eight hundred cars.

Frames 26.0 to 26.8 s. The 50 car grid is full. A tag reading Nearly 3,800 vehicles, 3,791 potentially affected in the record fades in at 26.2 s and sits above the grid. The hand lowers a wooden stamp onto the card and an orange rectangle stamp mark Software recall prints near the top right by 26.6 s, then the stamp lifts away at 26.8 s. Caption holds.

Frames 27.0 to 27.8 s. The wooden stamp and hand withdraw off the right edge by 27.4 s leaving the card with an orange Software recall mark, the Nearly 3,800 vehicles tag and the full 50 car grid. From 27.6 s the caption is gone and the final composition holds without change. Lower third beneath the grid is empty olive and dark green.

Frames 28.0 to 28.8 s. After the desk shot, a hard cut at 28.2 s to a wide side view of a straight multi-lane road with a white car entering from left and driving right, skyline and trees behind, green shoulder, label saying the recall wording is not a recorded event. A recall quote card fades in at 28.6 s reading The software may allow the vehicle to slow and then drive into standing water on higher speed roadways.

Frames 29.0 to 29.8 s. The white car drives along a straight road with the background trees and dashed lane marks sliding left, which reads as forward travel. The recall quote card sits upper left unchanged. No water or brake lamp is visible on the road yet. Caption The recall says the software may let a car slow, holds. The lower third is a flat olive green bank.

Frames 30.0 to 30.8 s. The white car lights its red brake lamp at 30.0 s and a grey blue pool of water drifts in from the right along the lane while the car holds position. At 30.8 s the brake lamp is off. Quote card unchanged upper left. Caption The recall says the software may let a car slow, holds.

Frames 31.0 to 31.8 s. The wide road shot continues with the puddle at the right edge for three frames, no brake lamp visible. At 31.6 s a cut to a large close side view of the white car with faint wake lines under the wheels and a water pool edge entering from the right at 31.8 s. Cabin shows two seated silhouettes. Caption now reads then drive into standing water on higher speed roads.

Frames 32.0 to 32.8 s. A close side view of the white car with the standing water pool edge sliding in from the right and reaching the car front by 32.8 s, rear brake lamp red at times. At 32.8 s the word may in the recall card is highlighted amber. The car stays centered, wheels with spokes visible. Caption then drive into standing water on higher speed roads.

Frames 33.0 to 33.8 s. The white car, brake lamp red, rolls forward so its front wheel enters a pool of standing water. Ripples and wake streaks spread around the front wheel from 33.4 s and splash dots appear by 33.8 s. The word may in the upper-left recall card is highlighted amber throughout. This is the picture for the clause then drive into standing water.

Frames 34.0 to 34.8 s. The white car stays centered as water spreads beneath and beside it with wake streaks and small splash dots at the front tire, the water pool reflecting the car bottom. Upper right a tree and pole drift by, indicating forward motion. The highlighted word may on the recall card remains. Caption holds then drive into standing water on higher speed roads.

Frames 35.0 to 35.8 s. Three frames hold the car moving through the pool with the may highlight. At 35.6 s a hard cut to the large recall card on the wooden desk with the Software recall stamp, Recall type Software and Potential units affected 3,791, with a large blank lower half of the card. At 35.8 s the caption about the remedy being under development appears.

Frames 36.0 to 36.8 s. The card shows Recall type Software and 3,791, and a peach Remedy row text types in to read The remedy is currently under development. by 36.4 s. From 36.6 s a hand with a pen enters from the right toward the row. The lower half of the card below the row is blank.

Frames 37.0 to 37.6 s. A pen held by a hand rests near the end of the line The remedy is currently under development. with no visible change across four frames. At 37.8 s the view zooms slightly and a second arm in a blue sleeve holding a wooden stamp enters at the bottom of the remedy row. Caption holds.

Frames 38.0 to 38.8 s. A wooden stamp held by a second arm hovers over the lower left of the highlighted remedy row for three frames, then lowers at 38.6 s and a partial orange outlined stamp mark beginning Und shows at 38.8 s. The pen arm stays at right. Caption holds.

Frames 39.0 to 39.8 s. The Under development orange stamp mark is fully printed at lower left of the remedy row at 39.0 s. Both arms withdraw to the right over the next four frames leaving the card with the two stamps. Caption gone from 39.4 s. The last two frames show the card static with empty olive area below.

Frames 40.0 to 40.8 s. A new scene of four white cars in a diagonal row on wet asphalt in a lot with a fence and trees, a Vehicle maps card and an April calendar page hang at upper right. A Weather limits tightened tag slides in from the left onto the wire from 40.4 s. Caption appears at 40.4 s. The foreground lower third is empty dark asphalt.

Frames 41.0 to 41.8 s. The Weather limits tightened tag with a cloud and rain icon hangs from the red pin on the wire and slides rightward across five frames. The four parked white cars, the April calendar page and the Vehicle maps card are static. Caption holds As an interim step, Waymo tightened its weather limits,. No check marks yet.

Frames 42.0 to 42.8 s. The only change across five frames is the Weather limits tightened tag swaying slightly on its pin. All four cars, the April calendar page and the Vehicle maps card remain the same. No check marks or car changes appear. Caption holds As an interim step, Waymo tightened its weather limits,. This is an extended hold of about two seconds on this composition.

Frames 43.0 to 43.8 s. Three frames hold the parked row and tag. At 43.6 s a hard jump to a lower, closer camera on the nearest car with the row receding behind it, tag and April calendar enlarged at upper area, and at 43.8 s the caption turns to and every affected car had the update by April twentieth. No check marks are on any car yet.

Frames 44.0 to 44.8 s. Circular badges above the cars turn from empty to a spinner to a black check mark in sequence from the nearest car to farther ones, with four cars checked by 44.8 s while the fifth badge is still an empty small circle. The April calendar page is unflipped in these frames. Caption and weather tag hold.

Frames 45.0 to 45.8 s. Four car badges are checked and the Vehicle maps card changes from an empty circle at 45.0 s to a check with the word updated by 45.2 s. From 45.4 to 45.8 s the picture is static with all checks, the April tab and its blank lined page unchanged. Caption holds and every affected car had the update by April twentieth.

Frames 46.0 to 46.8 s. The checks stay on all the cars while the April calendar tab at right flips from a blank lined page to a large 20 at 46.4 s, the old page folding up behind it by 46.6 s. The caption says and every affected car had the update by April twentieth. This calendar flip arrives about 2 s after the caption began and after the checks.

Frames 47.0 to 47.8 s. The checked row with the April 20 page holds unchanged for four frames with the caption gone from 47.2 s. At 47.8 s a hard cut returns to the airport curb with the white car parked in its bay, the phone card at upper left reading Arriving At the curb, the airplane sign and a new label saying a generic airport ride, not the flood cars.

Frames 48.0 to 48.8 s. The white car sits in the bay beside the airport curb. The phone card holds Arriving At the curb. From 48.6 s the car's rear door swings open and shows a dark interior at 48.8 s. Caption So the airport ride is open, appears throughout. Lower third is flat dark asphalt.

Frames 49.0 to 49.8 s. The car holds with its rear door open and tan seat showing. The phone card still reads Arriving At the curb. Nothing changes across five frames except the caption disappearing at 49.8 s. Lower third is again flat dark asphalt.

Frames 50.0 to 50.8 s. A new framing of the curb scene with the car door open and a small Federal recall record card with the Remedy row and an Under development stamp sitting on the road surface in front of the car, small in the frame and the type tiny at phone size. Caption and the federal record lists the flood remedy appears at 50.2 s. Phone card is replaced by a phone on the bench.

Frames 51.0 to 51.8 s. The recall card with the Remedy row and Under development stamp enlarges and slides toward the bottom left of the frame in front of the parked car with its rear door open, its text now readable. The car, airplane sign, bench and suitcase are unchanged. Caption holds and the federal record lists the flood remedy.

Frames 52.0 to 52.8 s. The same composition holds without change in all five frames: recall card with the Remedy row and Under development stamp over the lower road, the white car with its rear door open behind it. Only the caption changes to as currently under development. at 52.8 s. This is a static hold.

Frames 53.0 to 53.8 s. A split composition with the airport curb and the white car with its rear door open on top and a wooden desk below holding the recall card and a small phone card reading Arriving At the curb. A thick black underline draws left to right under under development. across the five frames. The car does not move. Caption as currently under development.

Frames 54.0 to 54.8 s. The split frame with the open-door white car and the recall card with the underlined remedy line holds still across all five frames. Caption disappears after 54.0 s. Nothing moves for 0.8 s besides tiny shading. The phone card still reads Arriving At the curb.

Frames 55.0 to 55.8 s. The same split composition of the open-door white car at the curb above and the recall card with underlined remedy and phone card on the desk below holds without any change or caption for the entire sampled second. The lower third of the frame is bare wood.

Frames 56.0 to 56.8 s. A dark navy credits card fades up from 56.0 to 56.2 s showing a Texas flag icon, the Texas AI Docket wordmark, a Visit the Docket texasaidocket.com row and four credit blocks for sources, illustration, map and music. The lower third of the frame is empty. After 56.2 s it is static.

Frames 57.0 to 57.8 s. The credits card is identical in all five frames: flag icon, Texas AI Docket wordmark, texasaidocket.com, and the four credit blocks. The credit text is small relative to the 1080 wide frame. Lower third empty.
Frames 58.0 to 58.8 s. The same credits card holds unchanged in all five frames with the flag icon, wordmark, link row and four credit blocks on a dark navy field. Lower third of frame is blank.
Frames 59.0 to 59.8 s. The credits card is identical in all five frames: flag icon, Texas AI Docket wordmark, texasaidocket.com link row and four credit blocks on dark navy. No motion or fade.
Frames 60.0 to 60.8 s. The credits card holds unchanged, with the flag icon, wordmark, link row and four credit blocks on a dark navy field and an empty lower third.

Final native frame at 60.967 s, frame 1829. The dark navy credits card with the Texas flag icon, Texas AI Docket wordmark, texasaidocket.com row and the sources, illustration, map and music credits is unchanged from the preceding frames. The lower third of the card is empty.
